main.description: Deploy the caller's ERC-4337 smart account on the etzhayyim private chain (chainId 260425) by resolving the caller to an ERC725 root DID, then calling `etzhayyimActorRegistry.activate(rootDidHash, [packedPasskeyPubkey])`. Legacy did:etzhayyim/did:web sessions must already be linked through `etzhayyimRootIdentityRegistry`; this procedure no longer hashes legacy DIDs directly. Caller must hold a session (passkey-first policy). The Worker reads the caller's primary passkey credential from D1 (`passkey_credentials` table), strips the 0x04 prefix from the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 pubkey to get a 64-byte X||Y owner, signs a sealer-sponsored EIP-155 legacy tx with the SEALER_PRIV secret, and submits via `https://geth.etzhayyim.com/eth_sendRawTransaction`. Idempotent on the contract side (re-activating returns the existing address). On success returns the same shape as `getActorAccount`.

didHash.description: ERC725 root DID hash, never a direct did:etzhayyim/did:web hash.

txHash.description: Transaction hash returned by eth_sendRawTransaction (only on first activation; idempotent re-call returns the existing address with txHash omitted)

errors.name: ConfigError
errors.description: ETH_PRIVATE_RPC_URL / etzhayyim_ACTOR_REGISTRY_ADDR / etzhayyim_ROOT_IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ADDR / SEALER_PRIV not configured

errors.name: RootIdentityRequired
errors.description: Caller is still on an unmigrated legacy DID with no ERC725 root facade link

errors.name: PasskeyMissing
errors.description: Caller has no passkey credential to use as the smart-account owner

errors.name: TxRevert
errors.description: Transaction was mined but reverted (e.g. malformed owners, registry rejected)
